title: Treasure Chest

{{Outdated| * What does the game consider as a "rare" goblin egg ? * What are the Loot Pools used for Structure Chests ?}} {{Infobox/Generic |title=Treasure Chests |image=Chest.png |label1=Category |data1=[[Mechanics]] |label2=Zone |data2=[[Crystal Hollows]] }} '''Treasure Chests''' are exclusive to the [[Crystal Hollows]]. Either dug or found in structures, they are the main way of gaining {{Gemstone Powder}}. {{For|Chests found using a {{Item|Metal Detector}}|Metal Detector#Drops}} __TOC__ == Treasure Chests == '''Treasure Chests''' exist in {{green|2}} types : '''Dug Chests''' and '''Loot Chests'''. ===Dug Chests=== [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] '''Dug Chests''' can be spawned anywhere except near the {{Item|Bedrock|link=}} walls. They have a lifetime of {{green|1}} minute before disappearing. * They are viewable by all players but only lootable by the player who spawned it. * The player must aim at the {{grey|critical}} particles ("{{Blue|Locks}}") on a face of the chest {{green|5}} times in a row to open it. Successfully picking a "{{Blue|Lock}}" plays a sound cue. Their number can be decreased down to {{green|0}}, making the chest instantly openable. * They have a {{Green|Base Chance}} of {{Chance|0.2%|1|500}} to spawn from mining {{Item|Hard Stone}} only. : When a block of {{Item|Hard Stone}} is broken, a random decimal number between {{green|0}} and {{green|100}} excluded is rolled. If that number is smaller than the player's {{Blue|Final Chance}}, then a [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] Dug Chest is spawned. :{|class="wikitable" |{{Blue|Final Chance}} = {{Green|Base Chance}} + {{Green|Bonus}}[[File:Emerald.png|17px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] perk + {{Green|Bonus}}{{Item|Scatha Pet}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} perk | |} :{|class="wikitable" | !Effect !Type of Source !Source |- !Decreasing "{{Blue|Locks}}" |{{green|-1}}→{{green|-5}}The fifth and final lock is removed at Level {{green|20}}. With a {{Item|Blue Cheese Goblin Omelette}}, this can be achieved at Level {{green|19}}. |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[File:Emerald.png|21px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] |- !rowspan="4"|Increasing {{Blue|Final Chance}} |{{green|+20%}}→{{green|100%}} |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[File:Emerald.png|21px|link=]][[Great Explorer]] |- |{{green|+0.3%}}→{{green|30%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=r}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |- |{{green|+0.4%}}→{{green|40%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=e}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |- |{{green|+0.5%}}→{{green|50%}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=l}}'s {{AN|Burrowing}} |} :At most, the player has a raw {{Chance|1.7%|1|58.82}} chance of spawning a [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] Dug Chest upon breaking a block of {{Item|Hard Stone}}. ===Loot Chests=== [[File:Chest.png|21px|link=]] '''Loot Chests''' can spawn in set locations within structures – provided these spawn. * They are viewable and lootable by all players. * They can be opened directly, with a small time delay. * The loot within a '''Loot Chest''' is always the same for all players who open it within that '''Crystal Hollows''' instance except in the following cases: ** For all of them, the amount of {{Gemstone Powder}} varieshttps://ibb.co/wd0WZkk. ** For the one inside the '''Trapped Sludge''' of the {{Zone|Jungle}}, the loot is entirely rerolled for each player. * A player cannot claim the rewards from the same '''Loot Chest''' on multiple profiles. ====Jungle Temple Exception==== {{See also|Jungle Temple}} Its {{green|2}} '''Loot Chests''' function differently: * They can only be claimed if the player has an "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. * They can be claimed once per "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. * The loot is entirely rerolled for each player and for each "active" {{Item|Jungle Key}}. In this context, an "Active {{Item|Jungle Key|link=}}" refers to the situation in which the player – {{grey|(A)}} – has given a {{Item|Jungle Key}} to a {{NPCSprite|Kalhuiki Door Guardian}} '''and''' – {{gray|(B)}} – has not claimed the {{Item|Amethyst Crystal}} afterwards. ==Loot== '''Treasure Chests''' roll in a Loot Pool depending on {{green|3}} factors: their {{Blue|Type}} ('''Dug''' or '''Loot''') ; their {{Blue|Tier}} ('''Low''' or '''High''') ; their {{Blue|Location}} ({{Zone|Jungle}}, {{Zone|Goblin Holdout}}, {{Zone|Mithril Deposits}}, {{Zone|Precursor Remnants}}, {{Zone|Magma Fields}}, {{Zone|Fairy Grotto}} – otherwise, a generic one is assigned). These amount to a total of {{green|28}} different Loot Pools. '''Treasure Chests''''s loot can be affected by modifiers. ===Tier=== Treasure Chests are '''tiered''': '''High''' or '''Low'''. {{Blue|High Tier}} Treasure Chests will roll in their appropriate {{blue|High Tier}} Loot Pool. {{Blue|Low Tier}} ones will roll in their appropriate {{blue|Low Tier}} Loot Pool. * '''Dug Chests''' have a {{green|5%}} chance to be of High tier. Otherwise, they are of low tier. * '''Loot Chests''''s tiers are set on prefabrication. In other words, they are generated along the structure they spawn in. ===Rolls=== By default, each '''Treasure Chest''' rolls {{green|3}}-{{green|6}} times in its appropriate {{Blue|Loot Pool}}, averaging to {{green|4.5}} rolls. This can be increased to a maximum average of {{green|5.15}} rolls by the following sources: {|class="wikitable" !{\color{green}x} chance for {{green|+1}} Roll !Type of Source !Source !Condition |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5.0%}}→{{green|50%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Bigger Box}} ({{Item|Hideoncave Shard}}) |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.1%}}→{{green|10%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Echo of Boxes}} ({{Item|Cuboa Shard}}) cascading on the above. |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.05%}}→{{green|5%}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Echo of Echoes}} ({{Item|Tiamat Shard}}) cascading on the 2 above. |{{bc}} |} ===Loot Modifiers=== By default, the amount of loot granted by a roll is {{green|1.0x}}. This can be increased by the following sources: {|class="wikitable !Loot Multiplier !Type of Source !Source !Condition |- |class="ct"|{{green|10%}} chance for {{green|+1.0×}} |[[Attribute]] |{{Attr|Crystal Serendipity}} ({{Item|Silentdepth Shard}}) |{{bc}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+1%}} → {{green|+50%}} |{{HotM|small=y}} perk |[[Heart of the Mountain#Powder Buff|{{AN|Powder Buff}}]] |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Ruby Drill TX-15}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+10%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Gemstone Drill LT-522}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+15%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Topaz Drill KGR-12}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+20%}} |[[Drill]] |{{Item|Jasper Drill X}} |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+1%}}{{ConfirmationNeeded}} |[[Drill Part]] |{{Item|Blue Cheese Goblin Omelette}} cascading onto the [[Heart of the Mountain#Powder Buff|{{AN|Powder Buff}}]] perk |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+0.2%}} → {{green|20%}} {{ConfirmationNeeded}} |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Scatha Pet|rarity=legendary}}'s {{AN|Bejeweled Eyes}} perk |{{Gemstone Powder}} |- |class="ct"|{{green|+5%}} → {{green|50%}} chance |[[Pet]] perk |{{Item|Goblin Pet|rarity=legendary}}'s {{AN|Free-range Eggs}} perk |"Rare" [[Goblin Egg]]s. |} === Dug Chests Loot Pools === {{Tabview |-|/Jungle Loot|Jungle |-|/Goblin Holdout Loot|Goblin Holdout |-|/Mithril Deposits Loot|Mithril Deposits |-|/Precursor Remnants Loot|Precursor Remnants |-|/Magma Fields Loot|Magma Fields |-|/Fairy Grotto Loot|Fairy Grotto |-|/Crystal Hollows Loot|Crystal Hollows }} === Loot Chests Loot Pools === {{MoreInfoNeeded|Lf Loot Tables}} == Game Messages == * {{Attr|Crystal Serendipity}} attribute activating: {{Dialogue|&a&lSERENDIPITOUS! &2Your Crystal Serendipity attribute doubled your rewards!}} == Tips == * For '''Treasure Chests''', aiming one or two block pixels above where the {{grey|critical}} particles are spawning may help to successfully pick the lock. A "pling" sound indicates a lock has been picked, meaning the player can advance to the next one. == Trivia == * If {{green|2}} '''Treasure Chests''' are spawned next to each other will appear as a single double chest, though they still act as {{green|2}} separate '''Treasure Chests'''. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|ahn-0.12-r1|Added '''Crystal Hollows'''.}} {{History|2024/Aug 20|Removed {{Mithril Powder}} from Crystal Hollows treasure and loot chests.}} |beta= {{History|0.12|Added '''Crystal Hollows'''.}} {{History|2021/July 27|Reduced Powder amounts from loot chests.|Fixed loot chest spawning in some rooms.}} {{History|2022/April 9|link=none|Disabled Loot Chests.}} {{History|2022/April 13|link=none|Re-enabled Loot Chests.|Loot Chests now immediately give the loot after opening rather than opening a Chest GUI.}} {{History|0.20.6|Removed {{Mithril Powder}} from Crystal Hollows treasure and loot chests.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Crystal Hollows}} [[Category:Mining]] [[Category:Locations]] == References == {{Cite Discord | url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529856177427448008/1547886297006342194 | channel = admin-info-request | text =
